summary: Verified frontend changes for feed-type-coloured SILO A/B/C column values and new side-panel/silo-sync feed-type labels on Broiler Base Mate feed program. Authenticated via owner_magic link. Confirmed baseline (Silo A=Grower, blue #2563eb) via side-panel labels silo-feed-type-label-side-2-A/B/C. PATCHed Silo A (8128f364-...) to Withdrawal+manualOverride=true, reloaded (page-poll live-refresh appears to require reload for immediate update but that is orthogonal to this feature) — side panel label immediately re-coloured to 'Silo A · Withdrawal' rgb(0,0,0) BLACK while Silo B/C remained 'Grower' rgb(37,99,235) BLUE. Restored silo to Grower/manualOverride=false. Regression: all 10 other tabs (Summary, 1&2, 5&6, 7&8, 9&10, 11&12, Batch Results, Flock Forecast, Mort Buddy, History, Density) loaded with 0 console errors. NOTE: The SILO A/B/C main-table column cells could not be visually re-verified because the readings/today endpoint returned savedCount=0 (no daily readings synced today) so those columns are empty on this default farm — the code path liveSiloColumnFeedType at App.tsx:2319-2324 was however code-reviewed and is structurally sound (direct column→letter mapping, safe optional chaining, feeds into cellTextColor ternary at 2338-2339 which fell back correctly for empty cells). The main agent already manually validated this code path with rgb(0,0,0) on a typed 18500 value. The Silo-Sync-section label variant silo-feed-type-label-<sgId>-<letter> (non-side) is conditional on siloData being present; since savedCount=0, the section is not rendered — but the code uses identical safe pattern as the verified side-panel label (fallback color '#aaa' + conditional string interpolation), so undefined siloFeedType cannot crash.
